user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT's search features.
user_agents.scope: ChatGPT search features to surface search results and navigational links.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety and relevance of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Only visits pages submitted as ads; data not used for training models.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content used for training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web content used in training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Fetch web pages for user actions in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated actions and GPT Actions; not automatic web crawling.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply because actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content to potentially contribute to generative AI model training.
user_agents.scope: Public web content crawled for AI model development.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for ClaudeBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Retrieves web content at users' direction when individuals ask Claude questions.
user_agents.scope: Websites accessed through user-initiated requests.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-User in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Analyzes online content to improve search result quality, relevance, and accuracy.
user_agents.scope: Online content indexed for user search optimization.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Finds information for Google's search indexes and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Video mode, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using user-agent Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawls images for Google Search and image features.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Video mode, and features displaying images, logos, or favicons.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using Googlebot-Image or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawls videos for video-related Google Search features.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using Googlebot-Video or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for the Google News product.
user_agents.scope: Google News product, including news.google.com and the Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using Googlebot-News or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for Google Shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping, including the Shopping tab in Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using user-agent Storebot-Google.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Powers Search testing tools like Rich Result Test and URL inspection.
user_agents.scope: Search testing tools in Search Console; has no effect on Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using Google-InspectionTool or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler for product teams fetching publicly accessible content.
user_agents.scope: One-off crawls for internal research and development across various product teams.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using user-agent GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Optimized version of GoogleOther for fetching publicly accessible image URLs.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible image URLs; does not affect any specific product.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using GoogleOther-Image or GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Optimized version of GoogleOther for fetching publicly accessible video URLs.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible video URLs; does not affect any specific product.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using GoogleOther-Video or GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Executes site owner requested crawls for Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Vertex AI Agents crawl requests; no effect on Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using Google-CloudVertexBot or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls content use for Gemini model training and grounding.
user_agents.scope: Future Gemini models powering Gemini Apps, Vertex AI API, and Search grounding.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using user-agent Google-Extended.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers Apple search technology across Spotlight, Siri, and Safari, and crawls web data.
user_agents.scope: Web crawling and rendering for Apple search and generative foundation model data.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt or use robots meta tags / X-Robots-Tag.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls use of crawled data to train Apple generative foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Does not crawl webpages; determines data usage for Apple generative AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a Disallow rule for Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content shared on Meta's family of apps.
user_agents.scope: Gathers, caches, and displays information such as title, description, and thumbnail image.
user_agents.opt_out: Add disallow in robots.txt; may bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality.
user_agents.scope: Analyzes online content to enhance accuracy and cite content in Meta AI responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow for the crawler in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web for improving advertising and business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Used for improving advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow for the crawler in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web for training foundation AI models or indexing content.
user_agents.scope: Training foundation AI models or improving products by indexing content directly.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow for the crawler in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at a user's request and supports agentic AI.
user_agents.scope: Fetches user-requested links and helps AI navigate websites to complete tasks.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt rules because fetches are requested by the user.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves Amazon products and services and trains Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Host-level web content; does not crawl disallowed pages.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt disallow directives or page-level robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences in Amazon products and services.
user_agents.scope: Web content for search experiences; excludes generative AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt disallow directives specific to Amzn-SearchBot or search bots.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Supports user actions by fetching live information for user queries.
user_agents.scope: Live web information fetched for users; excludes generative AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives due to user initiation.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Automated web crawler building open datasets for research and analysis
user_agents.scope: Randomly selected subset of web pages sampled across host domains
user_agents.opt_out: Add User-agent: CCBot Disallow: / in robots.txt or request opt-out registry addition.
